_how_to: One object per real physical print. Fields: id (unique), project (plaques | phone-cases | bookmarks | other), version (optional: a version id from the site, e.g. cc11-195-signed), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), printer, filaments (list), result (success | issues | failed | printed = printed, quality not recorded yet), notes, photos (list of paths in media/prints/), fan_art (true/false), source (where this fact comes from). Then run: python3 scripts/build_catalog.py && python3 scripts/build_pages.py
